title: Campfire — React query-group rerun arm
description: The Campfire chat contract (rooms, newest-first sequence-cursor pagination, reactions, live delivery) rebuilt as an in-repo rerun arm that consumes the LLP 0114 first-class React surface and a registered LLP 0112 generated query group, so a successor matrix rerun can score the React-surface path instead of driving only headless clients (LLP 0115 §Sequencing 5).

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

reactQueryGroupArm: the generated route group is register-eligible and identical between codegen and the prepared binding
the arm boots from one registered LLP 0090 bundle and renders that provenance plus the seeded room through the React bindings
sendMessage settles its exact result contract and the new message re-renders through the live React path
toggleReaction settles both directions and the live summary re-renders both counts
the shared newest-first sequence-cursor pagination contract holds
the arm component consumes only the React surface (structural pin)
unmount and disposal release every provider and server resource

capabilityGaps: room membership and authorized shared-room cursors (deliberately public, as in the Diary 0025/0034 Campfire arms)
notClaiming: any capability-class change (registered boot is startup consistency, not offline support)
live search (LLP 0136 is design-only; full_text_search_v1 stays non-live)
